invariants.source: handoff/product-brief.json invariants (unchanged in 0.4.0; tests/around.test.js holds them equal)

items.rule: Counts of two datasets are never added; no total of POIs is shown.
A dataset with no located record in the neighbourhood's province is out of scope there: “—”, never 0.
Every share shows its numerator and denominator (visible or in its title and accessible name).
Every rank names its peers with their number (“จาก N ย่าน …”).
Density uses the registry's area_m2, never a recomputed area.
Pairs and similar mixes are correlations, never stated as causes or performance.
Colour scales use all 41 LDS samples; the same HEX on light and dark; no opacity on a data colour.
Outlines are drawn as the registry delivers them (display simplification only) and called drafts.
Every panel view ends with one provenance line: dataset · source · date · boundary · วิธีนับ.
No caveat line on screen; method and limits live in DATA_METHOD.md.
The registry's address, export and cells never enter the repository.
Neighbourhood names stay Thai in English; no view is left untranslated otherwise.

An outline redrawn by the owner's rule (0.3.0) replaces the registry outline as an owner amendment: it only adds area, overlaps no other outline, keeps the registry's name, and is described as extended by the rule and awaiting the registry; never called the registry's outline or an administrative boundary
